title: Harden Phase 1.5 publication readiness
summary: Separate local, publication, and external readiness in the authoritative Phase 1.5 audit.
Add deterministic prepublication, PR metadata, reduced-motion, publication-denial, and provider-continuity controls.
risk: Medium: publication policy, browser motion behavior, and provider handoff contracts change without altering product scope.
The candidate is denied publication if any deterministic gate, metadata field, scope check, or diff validation fails.
testEvidence: The authoritative npm run ci:prepublish result is bound to the candidate SHA and appended to the published PR body.
GitHub independently reruns all protected workflows after publication.
documentationImpact: Update only canonical Phase 1.5 audit, current-phase, release, accessibility, and continuity documentation affected by these controls.
Phase 1.6 remains blocked until the external completion audit passes.
rollback: Revert this bounded closure-hardening commit through the protected pull-request workflow.
No database, business data, production deployment, or irreversible migration is introduced.
